items.name: Free charm
items.note: The charm unspools. Fire · Mercury → Fireball. The mite is burning matter. You borrowed a working; later you will compose others.
items.look: An orange twist of Free work. It still smells of the recipe it gave you: Fire · Mercury — hunger sent. The mite was burning matter. You borrowed a working; later you will compose others.

items.name: Fire stone
items.note: A stone that remembers hunger. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Warm even at rest. Hunger sleeps in it — Fire, the will to consume. The Gate of Elements has a socket this size.

items.name: Water stone
items.note: A stone that remembers yield. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: It takes the heat of your hand and keeps none of it. Yield, seated. Water thrown ends hunger.

items.name: Earth stone
items.note: A stone that remembers rest. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Heavier than it looks. Rest that will not be hurried. Earth · Salt stands a body.

items.name: Air stone
items.note: A stone that remembers breath. The Gate of Elements has a socket for it.
items.look: Almost not there. Breath that will not stay, seated just long enough to be sent. Air · Mercury is a gust.

items.name: Body stone
items.note: Salt, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a standing body.
items.look: Salt, seated. A standing body — the kind that makes a wall stay a wall. The Gate of Aspects wants this.

items.name: Spirit stone
items.note: Mercury, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a thing that goes.
items.look: Mercury, seated. A path opening, a thing that goes. Hold it and you remember that a send is not a wall.

items.name: Mind stone
items.note: Sulphur, seated. The Gate of Aspects wants a mind.
items.look: Sulphur, seated. The wildcard that turns a work toward a mind. Life · Sulphur · Mercury is Charm — they fetch, and they fight what you mark.

items.name: Grove artifact
items.note: A vegetable body, seated. Yield, rest, a standing plant, then Life.
items.look: Green-dark, and still a little wet. Water · Earth · Salt · Life — a plant asked to wake. The thicket remembers this.

items.name: Grove stone
items.note: A stone that remembers a living plant. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Yield and rest given a vegetable body, then marked living. Water the plants. The Gate of Joins will seat it.

items.name: Flood artifact
items.note: Hard water, seated. Yield given a body and asked to rest.
items.look: Cold and sure of its shape. Water · Salt · Earth — ice. A pool that learned to hold.

items.name: Flood stone
items.note: A stone that remembers water given a floor. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Water · Salt · Earth, seated. Ice is how a drowning channel becomes a path.

items.name: Spark artifact
items.note: Hunger given breath, seated. A seed of charge.
items.look: It stings the palm. Fire · Air is Spark. Spark · Mercury sends the bolt.

items.name: Spark stone
items.note: A stone that remembers a seed of charge. The Gate of Joins has a socket for it.
items.look: Hunger given breath. Fire · Air · Mercury is the bolt. The Gate of Joins has a socket that hums.

items.name: Spare grove artifact
items.note: An extra vegetable body from a path that was not the door.
items.look: The same green as the grove stone, older. Someone grew this way before you.

items.name: Spare flood artifact
items.note: An extra hard-water body from a hop over a door.
items.look: Cold brass that still smells of the cistern. Ice was not the only crossing.

items.name: Spare spark artifact
items.note: An extra seed of charge from a leap past the cell.
items.look: It ticks against the others. Breath and hunger, taken the long way.
